Subject: Q4 EMEA/APAC — ownership refresh & forecast lock request

Team —

Quick one to get us closed for the board forecast: please treat this as the last ownership refresh window before we lock Q4 numbers for finance. Action items below (short):

1) Ownership verification: confirm owner and stage for every opportunity in the attached matrix (EMEA_APAC_commit_matrix_2028Q4.xlsx). If you are not the owner, update HubSpot owner field and cc the new owner.

2) Commit threshold triage: escalate any deals > $100k that are at "Commit" or "Commit (at risk)" with a one-line reason and evidence (PO, legal signoff, SOW).

3) Deadline: update HubSpot and the matrix by EOD Monday, 13 Nov. Finance needs country-level committed numbers for invoicing planning.

4) If you expect a change to the committed amount after the lock window (e.g., pending procurement), flag it in the matrix under "Post-lock notes".

Reference: I pulled the latest HubSpot report (HS-90721) and started a consolidated tab in the sheet. Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EMEAQ4Commit

Attached: EMEA_APAC_commit_matrix_2028Q4.xlsx (master sheet).

Thanks — short and sharp here. Reply with confirmations or a one-line "working" so I can track.

Rachel Kim
Regional Sales Finance Lead | Redwood Inference
